api.notes: Required upstream; the element defaults to success and warns on an unknown value.
The dot's aria-label; the dot is a role=img on an inner element.
Built-in hover tooltip through TooltipController (shadow mode); a description, never the name.
Named slot; the wrapper is drawn only when something is slotted, so a conditional icon leaves the plain dot.

api.reason: A-ref: the element itself is the ref; the dot is reachable as part="base".
A-xstyle family: data-* attributes are set on the host directly; nothing to map.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|icon|tooltip) or the tokens.

differences.text: In forced colours the dot is drawn in CanvasText (GrayText for neutral) with a Canvas ink, so it does not disappear when backgrounds are stripped.

Plates are the Tecton status roles (--tecton-color-status-success/warning/error) with the dedicated --color-on-* inks; accent uses --color-accent, neutral the secondary icon colour with the surface ink.
The role and name sit on the inner dot rather than the host, so the tooltip's aria-describedby and the dot share one tree; author aria-* attributes on the host do not reach the img.

core.status-dot.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] role and name on the inner element; [mwg:interest-triggered-tooltips] and [mwg:position-aware-tooltips] via TooltipController; [mwg:css] reduced motion (--_animation-reduced) and forced colours.
